title: US STUNNED: World DUMPS Bonds to WORST Levels as Bessent Orders EU SELL Oil Reserves
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: 10-year at 5.32% and climbing; foreign and retail holders dumping Treasuries; worst confidence since 2007.
Iran escalation pushed oil back above $100; rate-hike odds by December ~82%.
Investors rotating from bonds into gold; buying rising despite ~10% drop.
US stocks propped by AI spending story but sit on a fragile foundation if high rates persist.
EU reserve releases are short-term relief; diesel could go higher when stockpiles deplete.

calls.reason: Investors demanding more compensation for sticky inflation and war-driven deficits; buyers dumping or refusing new issuance.
calls.quote: the 10-year Treasury yield just hit a new disaster level. We are now at 5.32% and it's still climbing

calls.reason: Long-duration Treasuries down 55% from 2020 peak; could take a decade to recoup as bonds keep losing value.
calls.quote: Bonds could continue losing value for years given its trajectory

calls.reason: Retail, funds and institutions buying gold as a store of value despite the dip, fleeing bonds.
calls.quote: people want gold. They want exposure as a hedge against all the craziness happening right now

calls.reason: Iran tanker strikes and blockade keep oil above $100; EU reserve releases only short-term relief, diesel could rise when stockpiles deplete.
calls.quote: the price of diesel could could really hit higher once stockpiles are depleted

calls.reason: Equities held up by AI narrative but fragile if rates stay high.
calls.quote: the US stock market sits on a fragile foundation that could crack badly if higher rates persist

notes: Transcript repeatedly renders 'Bessent' as 'Biden' (garble). No date stated; listing date used. Sean Foo is the solo host (no guest).
